What if it exports more than one item @francoischalifour? for example `instantsearch` exports `InstantSearch` & `InstantSearchOptions` etc. Case-only name changes are also a little tricky on git
@Haroenv We could either export `InstantSearchOptions` from `InstantSearch.ts` (since it's closely related), or create another `InstantSearchOptions.ts` file.

In https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/pull/4734 I'm adding different exports in most of those files (IndexUiState / UiState in ui-state for example). Do you think those should be in their own file or something IndexUiState should be exported from UiState.ts?
I think it's OK for `IndexUiState` to be exported from `UiState.ts`.
